rule: Per target, per control group, a diminishing ladder of 1, 0.5, 0.25, then immune (0). The level is read before a hit (duration scaled by it), the level moves up after the hit lands, and it resets after 15 s with no aura of the group active. Three types decide whether the ladder applies: ALL (stuns, a blind, a charm and one rogue opener) on any target; PLAYER (roots, fear and most other controls) only when both sides are players; NONE for limit-only groups. A new aura in the same group replaces the old one unless the old one is judged stronger. Stacking is a separate table: spell groups with UNIQUE or UNIQUE_PER_CASTER rules and a per-aura-type switch. A DoT fixes its caster-side bonus at landing and re-reads the target-side bonus on every tick. Fear and stun are independent flags with no priority between them.

look_test: Dummy target with a 375-wide status strip under its health bar: chips for stun, fear, root and immune. Three attackers chain a stun and the chip reads 100, 50, 25, then immune. Then one fear and one root. Compare with a flat stun using the same timings and no ladder. Dom judges: can he name the state in one second, does the third stun read as earned rather than broken, and does a fear read as runs-off while a stun reads as frozen. Style flag only, no release rows.
